discoveries.title: NTU Global Connect Fellowship 2027 — Singapore
discoveries.summary: Two-month funded research fellowship from 1 July to 31 August 2027 for STEM students graduating in 2027 or 2028, with a SGD 5,000 stipend and complimentary housing; applications run 15 January to 15 February 2027.

discoveries.title: USTC CSC Scholarship 2027 — University of Science and Technology of China

discoveries.title: Erasmus Mundus GrEnFIn Joint Master 2027–2029 — Greening Energy Market and Finance
discoveries.summary: Fully funded two-year joint master's in greening energy markets and finance across Italy, Germany and France, covering participation costs plus €1,400 per month for top-ranked applicants.

discoveries.title: KAUST Visiting Student Research Program (VSRP) 2027
discoveries.provider: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
discoveries.summary: Fully funded 3–6 month research internship in energy and other STEM fields with a $1,000/month stipend, accommodation, flights and insurance, with applications open all year.

discoveries.summary: Fully funded CSC Type B master's at Huazhong University of Science and Technology covering tuition, accommodation, stipend and insurance, including a Silk Road route that lists Pakistan.

discoveries.provider: Government of Hungary / Tempus Public Foundation
discoveries.summary: Fully funded master's in Hungary covering tuition, housing allowance, medical insurance and a HUF 43,700/month stipend, applied for through both Tempus and the home-country Sending Partner.

discoveries.title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships 2027–28
discoveries.summary: Fully funded taught master's at participating UK universities, with applications opening 10 November 2026 and closing 8 December 2026.

discoveries.title: MEXT Scholarship 2027 at Institute of Science Tokyo — International Graduate Program (A)
discoveries.provider: MEXT (Government of Japan) / Institute of Science Tokyo
discoveries.summary: A fully funded MEXT scholarship for master's and doctoral study in science and engineering at Science Tokyo starting September 2027, covering tuition and a monthly living allowance via university nomination.

discoveries.title: DAAD EPOS IWRM-MENA Scholarship 2027 — Integrated Water Resources Management
discoveries.provider: DAAD / TH Köln and German Jordanian University
discoveries.summary: A fully funded DAAD EPOS master's in integrated water resources management in Germany with a compulsory semester in Jordan, for graduates from DAC-listed countries with at least two years of relevant professional experience.

discoveries.title: Türkiye Burslari (Türkiye Scholarships) 2027
discoveries.provider: Republic of Türkiye / Presidency for Turks Abroad (YTB)
discoveries.summary: A fully funded Turkish government scholarship for master's study covering tuition, a monthly stipend, housing, health insurance, a Turkish language year and return flights, applied for once via the TBBS portal.

discoveries.title: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship 2027/28
discoveries.provider: Government of Hungary / Tempus Public Foundation
discoveries.summary: A fully funded Hungarian government scholarship for master's study covering tuition, accommodation, a monthly stipend and health insurance, requiring applications through both the Tempus portal and Pakistan's sending partner (HEC).

discoveries.title: CSC High-level Postgraduate Scholarship 2027 — Shanghai Ocean University
discoveries.provider: China Scholarship Council / Shanghai Ocean University
discoveries.summary: A full Chinese Government Scholarship for a three-year master's in China covering tuition, accommodation, a living stipend and medical insurance, applied for via Campus China as CSC Type B.

discoveries.title: Clarendon Scholarship 2027/28 — University of Oxford
discoveries.summary: A fully funded Oxford master's or DPhil award covering course fees plus a living-expenses grant, with automatic consideration for anyone applying to an eligible graduate course by its December 2026 or January 2027 scholarship deadline.

discoveries.title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships 2027/28
discoveries.summary: A fully funded one-year taught master's in the UK for citizens of eligible Commonwealth countries including Pakistan, covering tuition, return airfare and a living allowance.

discoveries.title: Erasmus Mundus STEPS — Sustainable Transportation and Electric Power Systems (2027)
discoveries.summary: A fully funded two-year Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in renewable energy, electric power systems and electric mobility, with a scholarship contribution of €1,400 per month for up to 24 months.

discoveries.title: Erasmus Mundus GrEnFIn — Greening Energy Market and Finance (2027–28)
discoveries.summary: A fully funded two-year Erasmus Mundus Joint Master training Sustainable Energy Experts across Bologna, Munich and Paris, with tracks in Renewable Technologies, Environmental Finance and Climate & Business.
